name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1933: The symmetric audit of the uniques ledger against both rosters. Of 389 rows, 265 are uniques, 119 are set pieces which live in both stores by design, and five match neither. Measured rather than guessed: two are the roster own curly apostrophe and resolve correctly because both normalisers fold the three apostrophe forms; one is a misread of Nagelring and one an annotated set piece, and in BOTH cases the real name is also in his ledger, so they are duplicates and not lost finds; the last is a set name sitting in the uniques ledger. His 267 of 403 is right and none of this changes it, because the scan counts against the roster so a row resolving to nothing cannot inflate it, and the write path is already guarded. They are therefore REPORTED and NOT REMOVED - deleting grail rows that cost him nothing, to tidy a number that is already correct, is an unasked-for edit to his history. Also recorded: the unique roster uses BOTH apostrophe forms, 83 straight and 4 curly, which every comparison here survives only because it goes through a normaliser that folds them.
